subtitle: What your assistant remembers about you
description: A digest of the interests stored in your device's assistant memory, built from octos.session.history. Refresh asks the assistant to summarize in its own words. Without an assistant service the app shows 'Assistant unavailable' and does nothing else. The reader half of a Notes + Digest pair that share one assistant memory.
release_notes: Second version: no local interest cache. The assistant is the source of truth; Refresh asks the assistant, Add writes 'I'm interested in X' to it. 'Assistant unavailable' is the only state on devices without an octos service.
